Materials and finish

Specifications and options

What should I measure for a carport or entrance canopy?

Give the length and width of the area to shade, the position of nearby walls or columns and the vehicle approach. If the canopy meets the gate, identify the entrance gate opening style so the team can allow for its movement during the survey.

  • Durable aluminum frame.
  • Protection from direct sun.
  • Wind and rain resistance.
  • Choice of styles and colors.
  • Polycarbonate or fabric covering options.
  • Low-maintenance materials for outdoor use.
